title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: ICT and security
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: CCTV cameras in the bowl
swms.task: Install CCTV cameras and data cabling around the bowl and roof edge, working from boom lifts more than 2 m above the ground.

facts.fallControl: Cameras are fixed from boom lifts with guardrails, with harnesses attached to the boom lift anchor points.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.harnessSystem: Workers wear a full body harness with a restraint lanyard short enough that they cannot be thrown from the basket, clipped to the boom lift's anchor point. Harnesses and lanyards are checked by the user before each use and inspected by a competent person every 6 months, recorded on the tag. Users are trained in working at heights and boom lift operation by a registered training organisation.
